trickyParts: A citation to code that still exists under the same symbol but with the opposite behaviour is worse than a stale line number: the reader checks it and is told the page is wrong. documentedClaims is that case, which is why its citation carries the symbol, the quoted old comment and the commit together.

The guides test cannot run in a fresh workspace without `bun install`, and that install rewrites bun.lock. The acceptance forbids a file outside docs/solutions/, so the lockfile was restored before the commit rather than after it.
deviations: Eight line citations were removed where review 5723093389 named three. The five extra were all true at the head; they go because the acceptance for this round reads 'neither page cites a line number', which is absolute. The other two pr2580 learning pages keep their twelve line citations, since the acceptance names two pages; the planner reported that inconsistency to the architect and it stands as the owner's call.
openQuestions: The ban on line citations is this issue's acceptance and not a rule in the tree: no AGENTS.md carries it, and skills/dispatch-writing-specs/SKILL.md scopes its version to specs. Making it a project-wide rule for learning pages would be an edit of skills/legion-retro/references/learnings.md, which is another issue's.
discoveredComplexity: The reply to a review is read by a required check: pr-title.yaml runs on pull_request_review, so check-pr-text.sh reads the reply's text, and pr-title must be read green after the reply as well as after the push.
